details.title: Strategy & Architecture
details.summary: Clarify priorities, compare technical options and shape a practical direction for your project.
details.decision: Which approach fits your goals and constraints?
details.boundary: Recommendations depend on the information available. Scope, responsibilities and deliverables are agreed before work begins.

details.title: Platform & Product Engineering
details.summary: Plan and develop the software, integrations and foundations behind a digital product.
details.decision: What does your product need to work reliably?
details.boundary: A project scope defines the supported systems, integrations and ongoing responsibilities.

details.title: Product Design & Experience Engineering
details.summary: Understand user journeys and turn them into clear, usable interfaces and interaction patterns.
details.decision: How should the product work for the people using it?
details.boundary: Research access, supported devices and accessibility criteria are agreed for each project. Designs alone do not establish accessibility compliance.

details.title: Commerce, Content & Growth Platforms
details.summary: Connect commerce and content journeys with the systems used to manage and improve them.
details.decision: How can content and commerce support your goals?
details.boundary: Sales, traffic and growth outcomes are not guaranteed. Platform costs and third-party services are scoped separately.

details.title: AI Systems & Agentic Automation
details.summary: Explore AI-assisted workflows and automation with clear information, evaluation and human-control boundaries.
details.decision: Where could AI help, and where is human control needed?
details.boundary: AI can produce incorrect output. Data access, source policy, evaluation and human approval need explicit agreement; no autonomous commitments are implied.

details.title: Data Platforms & Analytics
details.summary: Organise data flows and analytical views around the decisions your team needs to make.
details.decision: What data would help your team make a decision?
details.boundary: Useful analysis depends on source quality, access rights and agreed definitions. Data accuracy is not assumed.

details.title: Spatial Computing & Immersive Platforms
details.summary: Explore interactive 3D and spatial experiences with an equivalent accessible path to essential content.
details.decision: When would a spatial experience make an idea clearer?
details.boundary: Device support, asset rights and performance targets need project-specific validation. Essential content must remain accessible without 3D.

details.title: Creative & Visual Design Services
details.summary: Develop visual ideas and design assets that explain your message and support a coherent identity.
details.decision: What should your audience understand or recognise?
details.boundary: Asset formats, usage rights and the deliverable set are agreed in scope. No unlicensed imagery or third-party rights are implied.

details.title: Cloud, DevOps & Platform Reliability
details.summary: Plan infrastructure, delivery workflows and operational practices around your system’s requirements.
details.decision: What does your system need to run and recover?
details.boundary: Provider choice follows project needs. Costs, service levels and operational cover require separate agreement; no uptime guarantee is implied.

details.title: Security, Privacy & Trust Engineering
details.summary: Identify security and privacy requirements and plan how controls will be implemented and evaluated.
details.decision: Which risks and data responsibilities need attention?
details.boundary: This describes an engineering capability, not certification, legal advice or a compliance guarantee. Qualified review and evidence are required for assurance claims.
